about.label: About and help
about.tagline: A dice cup in your phone: shake it, hear the dice rattle, lay it down and read the roll.
about.intro: Real 3D dice in your phone, for board games, tabletop RPGs and dice games. The roll is read from the faces the dice land on, never from a random number.
about.description: Pocket Dice Cup turns your phone into a dice cup for board games, tabletop RPGs and dice games. The dice are real 3D physics inside the phone: they rattle against the screen’s edges as you shake it, with a clack and a tap of vibration on every hit, and come to rest when you lay it down. The result is read from the faces the dice land on, never from a random number.

shake.title: Shake to roll
shake.body: Shake the phone like a cup: a hard shake rolls the dice hard, a gentle one barely turns them. Lay it flat, screen up, to read the total.

settle.title: Settle
settle.body: In the hand, the dice slide to the phone’s low edge. Settle drops them as if it lay flat, and spins until the roll ends.

tap.title: Tap, click or press space
tap.body: On a computer, or with no motion sensor, tap the table or press space to throw.
tap.note: On a phone, a tap rolls again; held in the hand, the dice then drop as with Settle.

dice.title: Choose your dice
dice.body: Tap the dice button to mix up to {dice} dice, from d4 to d20. The result shows the total and each die.

rolledOver.title: Dice that did not roll over
rolledOver.body: A faint ring marks a die that only slid and ended on the face it started on. Shake harder for a fair roll.

history.title: History
history.body: Your last {history} rolls, kept on this device.

style.title: Style
style.body: Change the dice’s finish and the table. The dice roll the same in every finish and on every table.

feel.title: Sound and vibration
feel.body: Each hit clacks, louder the harder it hits, once you have tapped the screen, and the phone taps back where it can vibrate.
feel.note: iPhone browsers cannot vibrate, and the silent switch mutes the sound.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Everything stays on your device: no accounts, ads or tracking.
